pairs: Tunc Jesus ductus est in desertum a Spiritu,
Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the desert,
in order to be tempted by the devil.
And when he had fasted for forty days
And approaching, the tempter said to him,
“If you are the Son of God,
dic ut lapides isti panes fiant.
tell these stones to become bread.”
Non in solo pane vivit homo,
‘Not by bread alone shall man live,
sed in omni verbo, quod procedit de ore Dei.
but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.’”
Tunc assumpsit eum diabolus in sanctam civitatem,
Then the devil took him up, into the holy city,
et statuit eum super pinnaculum templi,
and set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
“If you are the Son of God,
Quia angelis suis mandavit de te,
‘For he has given charge of you to his angels,
and they shall take you into their hands,
ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
lest perhaps you may hurt your foot against a stone.’”
‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
Iterum assumpsit eum diabolus in montem excelsum valde:
Again, the devil took him up, onto a very high mountain,
et ostendit ei omnia regna mundi, et gloriam eorum,
and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory,
“All these things I will give to you,
if you will fall down and adore me.”
‘You shall adore the Lord your God,
and him only shall you serve.’”
Angels approached and ministered to him.
Cum autem audisset Jesus quod Joannes traditus esset,
And when Jesus had heard that John had been handed over,
And leaving behind the city of Nazareth,
he went and lived in Capernaum, near the sea,
at the borders of Zebulun and of Naphtali,
ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam:
in order to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:
the way of the sea across the Jordan,
populus, qui sedebat in tenebris, vidit lucem magnam:
A people who were sitting in darkness have seen a great light.
et sedentibus in regione umbræ mortis,
And unto those sitting in the region of the shadow of death,
Exinde cœpit Jesus prædicare, et dicere:
From that time, Jesus began to preach,
For the kingdom of heaven has drawn near.”
Ambulans autem Jesus juxta mare Galilææ,
walking near the Sea of Galilee,
mittentes rete in mare (erant enim piscatores),
casting a net into the sea (for they were fishermen).
et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum.
and I will make you fishers of men.”
At illi continuo relictis retibus secuti sunt eum.
And at once, leaving behind their nets, they followed him.
in navi cum Zebedæo patre eorum,
in a ship with their father Zebedee,
leaving their nets and their father behind,
And Jesus traveled throughout all of Galilee,
and preaching the Gospel of the kingdom,
and every infirmity among the people.
Et abiit opinio ejus in totam Syriam,
And reports of him went out to all of Syria,
et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes,
and they brought to him all those who had maladies,
those who were in the grasp of various sicknesses
and those who were in the hold of demons,
et secutæ sunt eum turbæ multæ de Galilæa,
And a great crowd followed him from Galilee,
